What it is

Your whole website, run from one dashboard.

The Nifty Websites AI builder is the platform behind every site we create — our own technology, tuned exactly for the websites we make. It gives you the control of a big content system with none of the complexity, slowness or security headaches, and it is genuinely easy to use.

The live editor

Edit your website live — just click and type

Every page is built from a finished, pixel-perfect design, then you edit it directly in the browser. Click text to change it, click an image to swap it, and drag whole sections to reorder them.

  • Click-to-edit text, images and buttons
  • Insert reusable sections and add elements
  • Preview desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile
  • Instant preview, publish in a click — with version history
yoursite / admin · editor
Built fast. Hosted safe.

The tech stack, in plain English.

No database and no plugins to slow the site down or be hacked. Here is what that actually means for you.

Lightning fast

Every page is pre-built and served ready to go, with no database to slow it down. Sites load in a blink.

Global edge hosting

Served from a global edge network spanning hundreds of cities, so the site is just as fast for every visitor, wherever they are.

Secure by design

Free SSL and DDoS protection come standard, and with no database or plugins there is nothing for hackers to exploit.

Reliable form email

Every enquiry is delivered straight to your inbox through a dedicated transactional email service, included with hosting.

Everything included

One platform, everything you need.

From editing pages to capturing leads, SEO and going live — it is all built in.

All Pages, one place

Every page on the site, grouped by category. Search, clone, set any page as the homepage, and see live/draft status at a glance.

Live visual editor

Click text to edit, click an image to swap it, drag sections to reorder. No code, no waiting on a developer for a small change.

Reusable sections

Build a section once and reuse it across pages. Update it in one place and every page using it updates at once.

Media Library

Upload, organise and reuse your images and logos across the whole site from one central library.

Every device preview

Design and check every page on desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile before you publish.

Built-in SEO tools

Broken link checker, 301 redirect manager, sitemap, robots.txt, LLMs.txt, GA/script tags and a custom schema generator.

Leads inbox

Every website enquiry lands in your dashboard with name, contact, service and page — and alerts to your email.

Launch Wizard

A guided checklist walks you from build to live — hosting, dashboard, homepage and custom domain, with progress tracking.

Branding & white-label

Your logo on the dashboard and sign-in, favicon control, and optional white-label so clients see your brand.

Roles & permissions

Create custom roles and control exactly what each team member or client can do, per site.

Backup & export

One-click backup and export of your whole site, plus find-and-replace across every page.

Custom domains & hosting

Global edge hosting, free SSL and DDoS protection, and your own domain connected over HTTPS.

Go live with confidence

A guided Launch Wizard

No guesswork about whether your site is ready. A step-by-step checklist verifies each part of going live — hosting, the dashboard connection, your homepage and your custom domain — with a progress bar so you always know where you are.

Never miss an enquiry

Every lead, captured in your dashboard

Enquiries from your website forms land straight in your Leads inbox — with the person’s name, contact details, the service they want and the page they came from — and alerts sent to your email, so nothing slips through.

mainEntity.name: What does Nifty Websites Australia do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. Every site is designed to rank in search, convert visitors into enquiries and drive growth, and includes a complete SEO build set up at launch.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the free SEO build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every website includes SEO-optimised content, schema markup on every page, technical SEO implementation, and Google Search Console and Analytics setup, configured for you at launch.

mainEntity.name: How much does a website cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia builds Starter sites from $699 and Professional sites from $1,499 on its own Nifty platform. eCommerce and custom builds on WordPress, Shopify or other platforms are quoted on enquiry. Every website includes a complete SEO build and a fixed quote before any work begins.
